scope.summary: Implement the Channels surface exposing per-document color channels, alpha channels, and spot-color channels with visibility, editability, reorder, rename, and thumbnail controls, and convert channel content to/from selections, spare channels, and masks (the same mechanism as MT-038/MT-031). Provide Duplicate/Split/Merge channel operations and the two channel-math ops: Apply-Image (blend a source layer/channel onto a target with blend mode, opacity, invert, mask, preserve-transparency) and Calculations (combine two source channels with a blend operation, outputting a new channel, document, or selection).
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate/Split/Merge + Apply-Image + Calculations proven; shares selection/alpha store
expected_tests: live: channels panel shows composite/color/alpha/spot channels; duplicate/split/merge channels; convert a channel to a selection
live: Apply-Image blends a source channel onto a target; Calculations outputs a new channel from two sources

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Channels, Apply Image & Calculations

risk_if_missed: No channel editing/channel-math; luminosity/alpha and prepress workflows blocked.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
